name: How long does stucco repair take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does stucco repair take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of stucco repair depends on the scope of the project. Small repairs, such as filling minor cracks, might take a few hours to a day. More extensive repairs involving larger patches, re-stuccoing sections, or addressing water damage can take several days to over a week. This timeline includes preparation, application of multiple coats (base and finish), and crucial drying/curing times between each layer. Weather conditions, particularly temperature and humidity, can also influence drying times and overall project length.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco repair duration varies: a few hours for minor cracks, several days to over a week for extensive damage. The process includes prep, multiple coat applications, and drying time, influenced by weather.
